objective: SoC設計を行い、CPUからLLMのキックをする
success_criteria: A CPU-side control path can write configuration, issue a kick command, and observe completion.
The kicked target is tied to the current LLM-serving RTL path.
CPU and hybrid execution are compared for the CPU-kick-visible outputs.
The evidence distinguishes a CPU-side sequencer/RTL proxy from a real CPU core and full LLM inference.

prompt_to_artifact_checklist.verification: The RTL top wraps the existing quantized KV-cache LLM proxy with a tiny instruction-ROM CPU model and has Verilator lint/build evidence.

The SoC harness now has a tiny instruction-ROM CPU model with PC, fetch/decode/execute, 11 retired instructions, 5 MMIO writes, 3 Q/K/V kicks, 3 done observations, and 24 proxy host requests accepted.
The SoC harness instantiates the existing quantized KV-cache proxy; it does not execute a full model graph.

prompt_to_artifact_checklist.prompt_item: CPU vs hybrid correctness is checked
prompt_to_artifact_checklist.verification: coverage_output_equivalence passes for 29 output words / 116 bytes with zero mismatches.
CPU elapsed is 3.26851 ms; hybrid wall is 78.443 ms; the slow hybrid result is attributed to 800 patch-script launches and is not a speedup claim.

prompt_to_artifact_checklist.prompt_item: Instruction-stream CPU model executes software-like program to kick LLM
prompt_to_artifact_checklist.verification: The CPU model fetches a fixed instruction ROM program: WRITE_SEED, WRITE_SHAPE, WRITE_TENSOR_Q, KICK_Q, POLL_DONE_Q, WRITE_TENSOR_K, KICK_K, POLL_DONE_K, WRITE_TENSOR_V, KICK_V, POLL_DONE_V, HALT. This is not RV32 architectural compliance or a production CPU core.

The Ibex path now instantiates ibex_top with a minimal RV32 ROM, MMIO bridge, and pulp_quantized_kv_cache proxy, the overlay lint passes as a 57-module design, and src/hybrid/Makefile has an ibex_llm_soc_kick_host_probe target. The first host probe reaches the ROM terminal loop, records 8 MMIO writes plus 1 status load, observes 5 proxy host requests, and reaches done. The first GPU cubin build passes, but the first hybrid launch fails with CUDA illegal memory access before coverage-output comparison.
The kicked target is the quantized KV-cache RTL proxy, not a full tokenizer/model graph/decoder path.

blocking_gaps: full LLM inference datapath is not connected

Ibex real-CPU path builds and host-probes through MMIO kick and LLM proxy request observation, but the first hybrid launch hits CUDA illegal memory access before CPU-vs-hybrid coverage-output equivalence
hybrid run uses 800 patch-script launches and is slow, so no serving performance claim is supported
non_claims: not a real production CPU core
not coherent cache or interconnect integration
not HuggingFace or MLPerf numerical equivalence
